raptors_liz_t1_opening.source: Live game 16/11 08:50, Raptors bot vs Liz (state/session.log lines ~6507-6560), the bot's first decision of turn 1 (hand and start spaces as dealt)
raptors_liz_t1_opening.good_player: Turn 1, five cards in hand and no target in reach: move without discarding a boost (the maneuver's draw refills the hand) and keep Ambush. The live bot discarded Ambush as a maneuver boost, then Working Things Out, then Pack Hunters: three cards in one turn.

raptors_liz_t2_echo_decoy.source: Live game 16/11 08:52, Raptors bot vs Liz, turn 2: Liz attacks Echo with Flame Lash (value 1) and the bot answered Decoy (state/session.log lines 6549-6560)
raptors_liz_t2_echo_decoy.good_player: Echo has 6 HP and nothing Liz can play kills it from here; the attack is face down and Liz is spending cheap actions. A good player does not pay a card to stop it: keep Decoy and Feint and take the hit.

raptors_liz_t2_echo_feint.source: Live game 16/11 08:53, Raptors bot vs Liz, turn 2: the second Flame Lash (value 1) on Echo, answered with Feint (state/session.log lines 6561-6573)
raptors_liz_t2_echo_feint.good_player: Same as the first Flame Lash: the Decoy is gone and the second one is not worth a card either.

liz_raptors_t6_back_and_forth.source: Live game 16/11 15:59, Liz bot vs Raptors human, turn 6 (state/session.log lines 6909 and 6913): maneuver 8 -> 9 then 9 -> 8. Approximate: Liz's HP and the Raptors' hands are estimates; the spaces are the log's
liz_raptors_t6_back_and_forth.good_player: Two maneuvers that end on the starting space draw two cards from a deck Wildfire is already burning and gain nothing. A good player moves once toward a useful space (the centre, or several zones for Wildfire) and uses the other action on something else, or does not maneuver twice.

liz_raptors_t14_back_and_forth.source: Live game 16/11 16:09, Liz bot vs Raptors human, turn 14 (state/session.log lines 7052 and 7056): maneuver 9 -> 8 then 8 -> 9. Approximate: Liz's HP and the Raptors' hands are estimates
liz_raptors_t14_back_and_forth.good_player: Same as turn 6: out and back with Rekindle x2 and Flame Lash in hand burns two draws for nothing.

liz_raptors_t20_back_and_forth.source: Live game 16/11 16:13, Liz bot vs Raptors human, turn 20 (state/session.log lines 7163 and 7167): maneuver 9 -> 10 then 10 -> 9. Approximate: only Raptor Blue's space is in that turn's log, the other two Raptors are placed as at turn 14
liz_raptors_t20_back_and_forth.good_player: Same as turns 6 and 14, now with Pyrotechnics and Burning Barrier in hand: spend the actions on something that changes the position.
